newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu hits new high for calendar '97.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu hits new high for calendar '97.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd shares rose to a new high for calendar 1997 on Wednesday morning as investors resumed trading activity, encouraged by better-than-expected results in the Bank of Japan's "tankan" survey, brokers said.
As of 0103 GMT, the shares were up 30 yen at 1,620, a new high for the calendar year, with 5.36 million shares traded.
"The 'tankan' survey was surprisingly good and issues such as Fujitsu, which were at the centre of trade in recent sessions, have come back to life," a broker at a middle-sized brokerage said.
